meta.title: Leaderboard
meta.description: Deadlock leaderboards by region, globally and per hero, plus performance boards from tracked matches.

title: Leaderboard
description: Click a player to open their profile. A tinted row means their latest ranked match promoted or demoted them.

notes.saved: The live leaderboard didn’t respond, so this is the copy saved {time} UTC.
notes.regional: Valve’s leaderboard (updated hourly): {shown} of the top {top} entries shown.
notes.regionalHero: Valve’s {hero} leaderboard (updated hourly): {shown} of the top {top} entries shown.
notes.ambiguous: {count} entries match several possible accounts, so they aren’t linked and have no current rank.
notes.global: Global: players with {min}+ tracked matches in the last 30 days, ordered by rank progress from their ranked matches. Built from tracked match data, not Valve’s regional lists.
notes.globalHero: Global: players with {min}+ tracked matches on {hero} in the last 30 days, ordered by rank progress from their ranked matches. Built from tracked match data, not Valve’s regional lists.
notes.performance: Players with {min}+ tracked matches in the last {days} days. Built from tracked match data; all regions.
notes.performanceHero: Players with {min}+ tracked matches on {hero} in the last {days} days. Built from tracked match data; all regions.
notes.winRateCaution: Top win rates over few matches are often luck; check each player’s sample and interval.

emptyDescription: Try another scope, hero or filter.
